Automated test suite

10 normal cases + 5 edge/fault cases. Synthetic test vectors are generated with a seeded PRNG (mulberry32, seed 42) so the same inputs are reproduced on every run. Each case cross-checks the array-based simulation engine used above against an independently coded string-based reference model of the same shift logic.

Assumptions & input format

  • Registers shift right: on every clock edge a new bit enters at the MSB (leftmost cell) and the old LSB (rightmost cell) is emitted as serial output.
  • All registers power up cleared to 0. In SISO/SIPO mode, bits before cycle 1 read as the initial zero content.
  • Input must be a binary string (characters 0/1 only). Any other character is treated as a fault and rejected before simulation runs.
  • For PISO and PIPO, the parallel load string must be exactly as long as the selected register width — a mismatch is rejected as a load fault rather than silently truncated or padded.
  • For SISO/SIPO, the input stream may be longer than the register width; bits that overflow the width are the ones already shifted out and reported as SO in earlier cycles.
  • "Generate" produces reproducible synthetic bit streams: the same seed and length always produce the same string, via a mulberry32 pseudo-random generator seeded client-side.
  • The clock is treated as ideal (no setup/hold violations, no metastability) — this is a logic-level, not a timing-accurate, model.
